request.query: If X is at least 2 and s log t is at most delta log X / 2, then t^s < floor(X)^delta for delta positive

      "informal_description": "For any natural number $ N \\geq 2 $, the inequality $ (2 \\cdot d - 1)^{\\lceil \\sqrt{\\ln N} \\rceil} \\leq N $ holds, where $ d = \\lfloor \\frac{N^{1/\\lceil \\sqrt{\\ln N} \\rceil}}{2} \\rfloor $ is Behrend's d-value and $ \\lceil \\sqrt{\\ln N} \\rceil $ is the ceiling of the square root of the natural logarithm of $ N $.",

items.informal_name: Behrend's Bound Inequality for Exponential and d-Value
items.informal_description: For any natural number $N \geq 4096$, the inequality $\frac{N^{1/\lceil \sqrt{\ln N} \rceil}}{e} < \left\lfloor \frac{N^{1/\lceil \sqrt{\ln N} \rceil}}{2} \right\rfloor$ holds, where $\lceil \sqrt{\ln N} \rceil$ is Behrend's n-value and the right-hand side is Behrend's d-value for $N$.

items.type: ∀ {N : ℕ}, 2 ≤ N → (2 * Behrend.dValue N - 1) ^ Behrend.nValue N ≤ N
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ N \geq 2 $, the inequality $ (2 \cdot d - 1)^{\lceil \sqrt{\ln N} \rceil} \leq N $ holds, where $ d = \lfloor \frac{N^{1/\lceil \sqrt{\ln N} \rceil}}{2} \rfloor $ is Behrend's d-value and $ \lceil \sqrt{\ln N} \rceil $ is the ceiling of the square root of the natural logarithm of $ N $.

items.type: ∀ (n : ℕ) {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → Real.log ↑n ≤ ↑n ^ ε / ε
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ n $ and positive real number $ \varepsilon $, the natural logarithm of $ n $ satisfies $ \ln(n) \leq \frac{n^{\varepsilon}}{\varepsilon} $.

items.informal_name: Behrend's Lower Bound Inequality: $ N e^{-4\sqrt{\ln N}} \leq 1 $
items.informal_description: For any real number $ N $ satisfying $ 2 \leq N \leq 4096 $, it holds that $ N \cdot e^{-4\sqrt{\ln N}} \leq 1 $.
